what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Yemen in Jordan: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3396 Yemeni asylum seekers in Jordan, 13.1% of all asylum seekers from Yemen.
Refugees from Yemen, a separate group, live mostly in Somalia, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, with Ansarallah and AQAP among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Yemen in 2015, 2017 and 2020.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 16 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 14059, at the end of 2019; the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Jordan.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Jordan only.
